heading: Claiming HRA and Home Loan Deduction: When It's Allowed
tldr: You can claim both House Rent Allowance (HRA) exemption and home loan interest deduction under specific conditions.
The primary condition is that your owned property and rented accommodation cannot be in the same city and self-occupied.
If you own a house in one city but work and rent in another, both benefits are generally permissible.
Even in the same city, if your owned house is rented out to a third party, you can claim both.
Proper documentation of rent receipts, rental agreement, and home loan statements is crucial to avoid tax notices.
caption:
Confused about claiming both HRA and home loan tax benefits? Many people think you can't, but you actually can under certain rules! For example, if you own a home in one city but rent and work in another, you could save more. Learn the simple conditions to claim both and keep more of your hard-earned money.
